title: Finite Topological Space Filtrations: A Topological Framework for Data Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2512.23348v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a data-analysis framework based on filtrations of finite topological spaces. Starting from a finite metric data set, we construct a sequence of coarsening topologies on the same set of points. These topologies give persistence modules and barcodes in the usual way, but they also retain information that is lost when the filtration is reduced to homology. At each level one can examine, for example, which points are topologically indistinguishable, how their minimal neighbourhoods overlap, how connected components merge, and how these features change from one level to the next.   We develop the basic theory of these filtrations, establish stability results under suitable hypotheses, and give practical constructions starting directly from a distance matrix. We then study what can be learned from the resulting finite topologies. On synthetic data with known clusters of different shapes, sizes, and densities, we examine

translated_title: 有限拓扑空间滤流：一种用于数据分析的拓扑框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于有限拓扑空间滤流的数据分析框架。从一个有限度量数据集出发，我们在同一组点上构造一系列逐渐粗化的拓扑。这些拓扑以通常的方式给出持续性模和条形码，但它们还保留了当滤流被约化为同调时会丢失的信息。在每一层，例如可以考察哪些点在拓扑上不可区分、它们的最小邻域如何重叠、连通分支如何合并，以及这些特征如何从一层到下一层发生变化。我们发展了这些滤流的基本理论，在适当假设下建立了稳定性结果，并给出了直接从距离矩阵出发的实用构造方法。随后我们研究了从所得的有限拓扑中能够学到什么。在具有不同形状、大小和密度的已知聚类的合成数据上，我们考察……
tldr: 本文提出基于有限拓扑空间滤流的数据分析框架，通过在同一数据点上构造逐层粗化的拓扑序列，在持续性同调之外保留了点的拓扑不可区分性、邻域重叠、连通分支合并等更丰富的拓扑信息，并建立了基本理论、稳定性结果和从距离矩阵出发的实用构造方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a data-analysis framework based on filtrations of finite topological spaces, which constructs a sequence of coarsening topologies on the same point set to retain richer topological information beyond homology-based persistence, together with foundational theory, stability results, and practical constructions directly from a distance matrix.
